The page is SignalWire’s REST API documentation hub. It highlights building communication apps using SignalWire’s platform, including REST APIs, Realtime SDKs, and guides. Key components include:
- REST APIs: Comprehensive reference for voice, video, messaging, and AI services.

- Platform & onboarding: Platform dashboard for managing spaces, numbers, and resources; Wirestarter for scaffolding projects; guidance for migrating from Twilio.

If you’re starting, you can set up an account, obtain API credentials, and begin integrating REST APIs and SDKs for voice, video, messaging, AI, and SWML into your applications.

/**
 * IVX Twilio SMS sender — fallback/alternative to AWS SNS for owner notifications.
 *
 * Uses the Twilio Messaging API (https://messaging.twilio.com/v1) to send a

 *
 * Credentials (two supported modes):
 *   - Auth Token mode: IVX_TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID + IVX_TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN

 *   - IVX_TWILIO_MESSAGING_SERVICE_SID (preferred — uses the ivxholding.com service)
 *   - IVX_TWILIO_FROM_PHONE (fallback if no messaging service configured)
 *
 * Marker: ivx-twilio-sms-2026-08-11
 */
